name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Complete
summary:
A vanilla+ graphical upgrade for the 2007 original game, S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl, created by a collective of professional artists, modders, and developers. This project elevates the game’s visuals and atmosphere while maintaining its iconic core experience. Featuring an updated UI, color-coordinated textures, dynamic shaders, advanced weather effects, and an immersive soundscape, it stands as the perfect entry point for newcomers to the franchise.

The mod integrates ZRP fixes, 4K, 16:9, 21:9 support, EE cutscenes, expanded AI, updated weapons, quality-of-life improvements; offering players a refined and visually stunning rendition of the beloved classic.
